topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Pathogen sensing and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms by which the innate immune system detects infection and cellular damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Cellular inflammatory response, recruitment, and systemic consequences
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated sentinel cells orchestrate the recruitment of circulating leukocytes to tissues and the systemic consequences that can result from severe inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the physiological processes that turn off inflammation, restore damaged tissues, and manage persistent inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next topic
topics.groupedBecause: It closes the lecture and announces the topic of the following session.
